content: Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' nite' lao beṉe' gwnabia' ca'

Ṉe' chesoe'lente Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' beṉe' ca' diža' cate' besežin baḻ bx̱oz c̱he beṉe' Israel ca', na' beṉe' gwnabia' c̱he ben' chesape' yodao' blao c̱hegaque'na' na' beṉe' saduceo ca' beṉe' cbi chesejḻe'e še yesyeban beṉe' guat ca'.
Beṉe' ca' cheseže'e c̱he dan' chososed chosolo'e Pedroa' len Juanṉa', ḻe chesene' ṉezecho gwžin ža cate' yesyeban beṉe' guat ca' da' beban Jesúsen'.
Na' beṉe' blao ca' gosezene' Pedroa' len Juanṉa' na' goseyix̱jue' ḻegaque' ḻižya do yel, ḻe ba chx̱in na' bi goḻa' yesone' yeḻa' justis c̱hegaquen' ca cheyaḻa' že'na', san bosocuezen' beteyoch.
Na' ca nac beṉe' ca' gosende' chesoe' Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' xtiža' Diosen', zane' gosejnilaže' Criston', na' txen len beṉe' ca' ba gosejnilaže'ne' cana', gosac do gayo' mil beṉe' byo cbi cuent no'ole.
Na' beteyo beṉe' gwnabia' c̱he beṉe' Israel ca', beṉe' gole blao ca' na' beṉe' bososed bosolo'e ley dan' bzoj da' Moisés, besedop besežague' ciuda Jerusalénṉa'
len Anás ben' naquech bx̱oz blao, na' len Caifás, na' Juan, na' Alejandro na' nochle beṉe' zjanaque' biše' ḻjež ben' naquech bx̱oz blaon'.
Na' gosone' mandadw jasexi'e Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' na' cate' ba zjazie' laogaquen' goseṉabde' ḻegaque': ―¿No beṉ ḻsens c̱hele cont beyonḻe beṉe' nxiṉjen'? o ¿no yeḻa' guac c̱he bc̱hinḻe beyonḻene'?
Na' Spiritw che Diosen' dan' yo'o ḻo' yic̱hjlaždao' Pedroa' benen cont gože' beṉe' ca': ―Le'e beṉe' gwnabia' na' beṉe' gole beṉe' blao c̱he nación Israel c̱hechon',
chṉable nac bento' da' güen beyonto' bena' nxiṉj ṉi'ena'.

Le'e na' yogo' beṉe' gualaž cheyaḻa' ṉezele Jesucriston' ben' naque' beṉe' Nazaret bene' yeḻa' guac c̱he' cont beyacšagüe' benga. Le'e betwle Jesucriston' bda'lne' to ḻe'e yag cruz, perw Diosen' bec̱his bosbane'ne' ladjo beṉe' guat ca'.
Bi gwyejḻe'le c̱he Jesucriston', da'nan' zaca'leble ca beṉe' cheson yo'o beṉe' bi chesazlaže' yej güen da' ba naquen yej squin c̱he yo'ona'.
Toze Jesucriston' guac goṉe' chio' yeḻa' mban toḻi tocaṉe, na' noch no zoa doxen ḻo yežlion' beṉe' gac goṉe' yeḻa' mban toḻi tocaṉe c̱he chio' beṉac̱h.
Besyebane beṉe' gwnabian' can' boži'i Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' xtiža'gaquen' sin cbi besežebe', ḻe nacbia' zjanaque' beṉe' yix̱e' na' bi zjansedteque'. Nach gosacbe'ede' ḻegaquen' ba gosedalene' Jesúsen'.
Na' dan' zecha ben' beyaque ṉi'ena' txen len Pedroa' na' Juanṉa', bi besyežele beṉe' gwnabian' bi yeseṉe' c̱hegaque'.
Nach beṉe' gwnabian' besyebeje' postlw ca' chyo'ole šlac bosoxi'e ḻegacze' nacle yesone'.
Na' beṉe' gwnabian' gose' ḻježgaque': ―¿Bi goncho len beṉe' quinga? Yogo' beṉe' že' ciuda Jerusalén ni zjaṉezde' gosone' to yeḻa' guac xen na' bi gac ye'cho beṉe' bi gosone' yeḻa' guaquen'.
Ḻetechoze goncho cont cbi gaslas diža' dan' cheso'ena'. Da'nan' cheyaḻa' ye'cho ḻegaque' gata' castigw c̱hegaque' še yesoe'che' xtiža' Jesúsen'.
Nach gosaxe' Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' da' yoble na' gose'e ḻegaque' bich yeso'e diža' c̱he Jesúsen' na' noch no yososed yosolo'ede'.
Nach Pedroa' na' Juanṉa' bosyoži'e xtižen' gose'e ḻegaque': ―Ḻe gon xbab c̱he da' nga, ¿chaquele chaclaže' Diosen' gwzenagto' c̱hele o še chaclaže' gwzenagto' c̱he ḻe'?
Bi gac cuezto' bich güe'to' diža' c̱he da' ba ble'eto' na' ba beneto'.

Na' da' zan da' gose' beṉe' gwnabia' ca' ḻegaque' cont yosošebe'ne'. Perw na' bi beseželde' nacle yesone' ḻegaque' castigw, ḻe beṉe' zan chesonxene' Diosen' dan' beyac bena' len yeḻa' guac c̱he Diosen'. Ba gwdie' c̱hoa iz na' ca goljte' bi goc se'e. Nach bososane' Pedroa' na' Juanṉa'.
Goseṉabde' Diosen' gaclene' yeso'e xtiže'na' sin cbi yesežebe'

Na' Pedroa' len Juanṉa' cate' bososan beṉe' gwnabian' ḻegaque' jaya'aque' gan' nita' yezica'chle beṉe' chesejnilaže' Criston' na' gosoe'lene' ḻegaque' diža' yogo'ḻoḻ can' gose' bx̱oz gwnabia' ca' na' beṉe' gole blao ca' ḻegaque'.

Na' cate' gosende' dan' gose' Pedroa' len Juanṉa' ḻegaque', toze can' gosone' xbab na' bosoḻ güiže' Diosen', gosene': ―X̱anto' Dios, len' beno' yaban' na' yežlion' na' nisdaon'. Len' beno' beṉac̱h na' be ca' chesaš na' bica'chle da' zjade, na' len' chnabi'o doxen.
Na' le' beno' cont da' rey David bzoje' diža' quinga dan' gož Spiritw c̱hion' ḻe', žan:

content.text: Beṉe' ca' cbi zjanaque' beṉe' Israel chesase' contr le', X̱anto' Dios,
perw bicze gac can' chesone' xbaben'.
Beṉe' gwnabia' c̱he nación ca' na' c̱he yež ca'
txen zjanaque' chesone' contr le' X̱anto' Dios,
na' contr Xi'iṉo' Criston' ben' gwseḻo' cont ṉabi'e.

content: ’Na' X̱anto' Dios, naquen da' ḻi rey Herodes na' Poncio Pilato na' beṉe' cbi zjanaque' beṉe' Israel gosaque' txen len beṉe' Israel ca' ḻo ciuda nga. Na' yogüe' gosone' txen cont gosote' Xi'iṉo' Jesúsen' ben' nac beṉe' laždao' xilaže' juisyw, ben' gwlejo' cont ṉabi'e.
Gosone' can' gwc̱hogbi'o gac dan' bžio' bia' cani'te.
Na' ṉa'a X̱anto', gwṉa can' cheson beṉe' gwnabia' ca', ḻe chesaclaže' yosošebe' neto' beṉe' güen žin c̱hio'. Na' goclen neto' cont bi žebto' güe'to' xtižo'na'.
Na' cate' güe'to' xtižo'na' blo'ešca yeḻa' guac c̱he Xi'iṉo' Jesúsen' beṉe' laždao' xilaže' juisyon' cont gac yeḻa' guac, na' yesyeyac no beṉe' chesacšene na' gac bichle da' yesyebane beṉe'.
Na' cate' beyož bosoḻ güiže' Diosen', Diosen' bene' gwxo' gan' zjandop zjanžague'na' na' Spiritw c̱he'na' gwzoachguan len ḻegaque', nach goso'e xtiža' Diosen' sin cbi besežebe'.
Gosone' dan' zjade c̱hegaque' toze

Na' yogo' beṉe' ca' gosejnilaže' Criston' toz ca gosac yic̱hjlažda'ogaque'. Na' yogo' bi da' zjade c̱hegaque' gosonen' toze, na' nono gwna: “C̱hia' da' nga”, o “C̱hia' da' na'”, ḻe naquen c̱he yogo'ḻoḻ gaque'.
Na' postlw ca' len yeḻa' guac xen c̱he Diosen' bosozejni'ide' beṉe' Jesúsen' bebane' ladjo beṉe' guat ca'. Na' Diosen' goclenchgüe' ḻegaque' len bi dan' gosone'.
Na' bibi goc falt bi da' beseyažje beṉe' gosejnilaže' Criston', ḻe beṉe' zjanape' no yežlio o no yo'o gosoten'. Na' mechw dan' besele'ede' c̱he to ton
bosonežjuen' postlw ca', na' postlw ca' goseyisen' len beṉe' beseyažjden'.
Can' ben to beṉe' Chipre beṉe' le José. Naque' xi'iṉ diaža c̱he da' Levin' na' postlw ca' bososi'ene' Bernabé, zeje diža' ben' cheyonxenḻaže' beṉe'.
Joséna' bete' to yežlio c̱he' na' mechw dan' ble'ede' c̱hen bnežjuen' postlw ca'.
